description: PayTR iFrame (hosted checkout) integration — pure LOOK, no SDK. Builds the get-token request and its HMAC-SHA256 token exactly as PayTR's own Postman collection does, gives you the hosted-payment iframe URL, and verifies the server-to-server payment notification (timing-safe). Token, callback hash and URL-encoding are verified bit-exact against an independent HMAC oracle; not yet exercised against a live PayTR merchant account.
author: codlook
